title: Disappointed
text: Disappointed. I was so excited to receive this product, I've wanted one for as long as I can remember. However, as soon as I started setting it up I had problems. It didn't want to stay on the tracks and it doesn't have a good seal. There's a good size gap in the back. Its also pretty hard to put together. Once we finally got it together, we were surprised at how small it was on the inside. It doesn't even hold a loaf of bread. It does have a shelf in the middle. The door is hard to open. I personally wouldn't recommend this especially with the little space and how hard it was to put together.
